summary: All five SPEC items are implemented as designed and tested. Timer handling in opened(): the timer starts after factory.open (no stray timer if open throws), every first event (blocked, upgradeneeded, success, error) clears it, giveUp is idempotent via the settle guard, and the only possible second reject (onerror after a timeout) is a no-op on an already-settled promise, so no stray timers or double rejection. Tidy-ups done (reset removed, dead guard removed, docblock rewrapped; SPEC-03 command passes). hold-writes.ts change keeps `sessions` as the held store whenever it is in scope, so pause-history (default ['sessions']) and end-session-hardening (['hands','reports','sessions']) behave exactly as before; SPEC-05 e2e run: 20/20 passed on chromium and webkit. upgrade-blocked.test.ts: 7/7 passed. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
